Content, social, video, PR & events08 / 12

One story. Different channels. Different audiences.

One verified project or people storyApproved facts, scope, people permissions and intended audience
WebsiteFull case studySearch + AI discovery
LinkedInProject insightEngineer + executive voice
VideoVisual explanationInterview + subtitles
Industry mediaRelevant angleTechnical credibility
EventsExpert briefingStakeholder discussion
Business developmentAccount materialRelevant follow-up
Relevant awareness · trust · stakeholder engagement

What my social review showed: LinkedIn already covers projects, news and milestones well. There is room for more engineer perspectives, technical explanations and people stories that give each audience a stronger reason to engage.

The benefit: one well-developed story can inform a buyer, support a sales conversation and give an event speaker useful material. Each channel gives the same evidence a different purpose.

AI integration · practical example09 / 12

How AI would help us work better

Before · project facts

Alfanar Projects played a role in delivering a battery energy storage system in Bisha. The facility provides 2,000 MWh of storage using 488 units and can deliver up to 500 MW over four hours.

→

After · AI-assisted, human-approved

How Bisha BESS strengthens the case for grid-scale storage

As power systems add more renewable generation, storing energy for when demand rises becomes increasingly important. In Bisha, Alfanar Projects contributed to the delivery of a 2,000 MWh battery energy storage system for Saudi Electricity Company. With 488 units and up to 500 MW over four hours, it shows the scale at which storage can support grid flexibility and renewable integration.
